title: Synthetic review of condition families presenting as fever
publisher: Synthetic Journal of Public Health Methods
licence: SYNTHETIC test data - no real licence
abstract: [SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT] A fictional review of condition families that can present as fever. It gives context for a verifier and does not allow a diagnosis from reported counts.

excerpts.text: Reported fever counts are a syndromic signal and not a diagnosis; clinical and laboratory assessment is needed.
Vector-borne and other infectious condition families are associated with undifferentiated fever.
